findings.music: All seven M4A tracks are documented as original stdlib synthesis in the dated 2026-08-24 Audio README music status, RadioStation and generator. Kevin MacLeod/OpenGameArt music rows are retained fallback plans, not evidence that those tracks were bundled. No generator or asset modification was performed.
findings.SFX: All 60 non-voice WAV basenames have prompts in SFX-SPEC; the repository identifies ElevenLabs generation. The dated July 18 log covers an older 34-file subset, not a verified date for the full current 60 effects.
findings.voices: All 12 voice WAVs have exact authored lines and standard Jessica, Laura or Brian voice selections in SFX-SPEC and generate_voices.sh. They are generated TTS, not user voice cloning.
findings.models: 368 converted USDZ files exactly match both final signed archives. Graphics README records Kenney packs, Quaternius and optional Fertile Soil racetrack source. Seventeen included source-pack license files explicitly name CC0; Fertile Soil primary publication also lists CC0. This review did not regenerate every model or establish individual conversion history for all 368 files.
findings.generatedBackgroundArt: Higgsfield art spec is a candidate plan with an empty generation log and no Graphics/Generated directory. It is not evidence of shipped AI background art. Home tile art is documented as Blender renders of the actual CC0 source GLBs.
findings.creditClaim: Graphics README says creators are credited in an About screen, but a native source search did not locate that screen. Attribution is not required by these CC0 documents, so this historical documentation claim is not used as release evidence.

unresolved.status: Repository does not record the paid subscription/plan in effect when these effects and voices were generated, nor service Beta status. Do not infer rights from the existence of an API key or from a currently active subscription. Owner evidence is required before affirming this generated-audio content-rights claim.
unresolved.source: Audio/SFX-SPEC.md Regeneration & licensing asks that plan/date be recorded; actual dated generation note omits the plan.

nativeAgeContentObservations.voices: Twelve scripted short robot-racer catchphrases in SFX-SPEC. No explicit language, sexual content or real-person impersonation in those written lines. No independent full audio audition claimed.
nativeAgeContentObservations.effects: Prompts describe cartoon toy crashes, cheers, gentle UI sounds and engines. These are not news, third-party songs, advertisements or user-generated online media.
nativeAgeContentObservations.gameplay: Toy racing includes cartoon collisions, scattered vehicle parts and playful driver reactions. This is an observation for the release owner, not an automated age-rating decision.
